title: 三隻小豬
description: 經典童話故事，三隻小豬建造房子的故事

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs.
sentences.zh: 從前有三隻小豬。

sentences.en: They left home to seek their fortune.
sentences.zh: 他們離開家去尋找運氣。

sentences.en: The first pig built a house of straw.
sentences.zh: 第一隻小豬用稻草建造房子。

sentences.en: The second pig built a house of sticks.
sentences.zh: 第二隻小豬用樹枝建造房子。

sentences.en: The third pig built a house of bricks.
sentences.zh: 第三隻小豬用磚塊建造房子。

sentences.en: A big bad wolf came to the first house.
sentences.zh: 一隻大野狼來到第一間房子。

sentences.en: Little pig, little pig, let me come in!
sentences.zh: 小豬，小豬，讓我進去！

sentences.en: Not by the hair of my chinny chin chin!
sentences.zh: 休想！絕對不讓你進來！

sentences.en: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!
sentences.zh: 那我要用力吹，把你的房子吹倒！

sentences.en: The wolf blew down the straw house.
sentences.zh: 野狼把稻草屋吹倒了。

sentences.en: The first pig ran to the second pig's house.
sentences.zh: 第一隻小豬跑到第二隻小豬的房子。

sentences.en: The wolf came there too.
sentences.zh: 野狼也追到那裡。

sentences.en: Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!
sentences.zh: 小豬們，小豬們，讓我進去！

sentences.en: Not by the hair of our chinny chin chin!
sentences.zh: 休想！絕對不讓你進來！

sentences.en: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house down!
sentences.zh: 那我要用力吹，把你們的房子吹倒！

sentences.en: The wolf blew down the stick house.
sentences.zh: 野狼把樹枝屋吹倒了。

sentences.en: Both pigs ran to the brick house.
sentences.zh: 兩隻小豬都跑到磚塊房子。

sentences.en: The wolf tried to blow down the brick house.
sentences.zh: 野狼試著吹倒磚塊房子。

sentences.en: But he could not blow it down.
sentences.zh: 但是他吹不倒。

sentences.en: The wolf went down the chimney.
sentences.zh: 野狼從煙囪爬下去。

sentences.en: The clever pig had a pot of hot water ready.
sentences.zh: 聰明的小豬準備了一鍋熱水。

sentences.en: The wolf ran away and never came back.
sentences.zh: 野狼跑走了，再也沒有回來。

sentences.en: The three pigs lived happily ever after.
sentences.zh: 三隻小豬從此過著幸福快樂的生活。

words.zh: 從此過著幸福快樂的日子
